summary.text: Annessa Hartman is a Democrat who serves Oregon House District 40, which includes Oregon City, Gladstone and unincorporated Clackamas County.

paragraphs.text: Hartman is a member of the Haudenosaunee, Cayuga Nation, Snipe Clan, and is the third Indigenous person elected to the Oregon House of Representatives.

Her official biography says her legislative focus on working families, human services and infrastructure stems from being the child of a single, working mother and from being a Gladstone City Councilor.
Her background is in events and hospitality.
